templates.title: Studio templates
templates.description: Box designs customers can start from — drafted, sent for approval, and shown in the studio once approved.

elements.title: Shapes, icons and marks
elements.description: Pieces customers place on a design in the studio. Shown once published; retiring one leaves existing designs intact.

reviews.title: Customer reviews
reviews.description: New reviews wait for moderation before they show on the site. Publish, hide or reply on Packio's behalf.

line.title: LINE
line.description: Rich menus of the LINE Official Account for followers and for members who linked their account.

privacy.title: Privacy and agreements
privacy.description: PDPA export and deletion requests with their due dates, consent texts, and the agreements customers and partners accept.

canned.title: Canned responses
canned.description: Thai and English texts customer service drops into a chat reply.

templates.title: Templates
templates.name: Name
templates.familiesHint: The library's box families this template fits.
templates.formIntro: Start from a library template or paste a layout JSON. A new template stays a draft until it is sent for approval.
templates.fromLibraryHint: Fills in the code, names and layout; edit from there.
templates.layoutHint: Faces and the slots for text, images and logos — the map below shows what was read.
templates.layoutInvalid: The layout can't be read. Check the JSON and the face names.
templates.layoutUnreadable: This template's layout can't be read.
templates.incomplete: Fill in the code and both names.

done.approve: Approved — the template shows in the studio

templates.emptyHint: Add templates from the library so customers can start designing faster.
templates.codeHint: Lower-case letters, digits, - and _, e.g. pk-tpl-coffee-classic
templates.codeInvalid: Codes use lower-case letters, digits, - and _ (2–64 long).

elements.title: Shapes, icons and marks
elements.name: Name
elements.tagsHint: Search words in the studio, comma-separated.
elements.pathHint: The path's d attribute in a 100 × 100 box.
elements.requiresRightHint: A mark with legal meaning, such as a certification — customers place it only after declaring they have the right.
elements.formIntro: A new element stays a draft until it is published.
elements.incomplete: Fill in the code, names and SVG path.
elements.codeHint: Lower-case letters, digits, - and _, e.g. recycle-loop
elements.codeInvalid: Codes use lower-case letters, digits, - and _ (2–64 long).

reviews.title: Reviews
reviews.replyHint: Shown under the review as Packio.

line.title: Rich menus
line.intro: Register a rich menu created in LINE by key. One menu is active per audience.
line.keyHint: A lower-case letter, then lower-case letters, digits or _, e.g. member_main. Reuse a key to change its menu.
line.providerHint: The richmenu-… ID LINE issued when the menu was created.
line.incomplete: The key takes lower-case letters, digits and _; fill in the rich menu ID.

requests.title: Customer requests
requests.completeExportBody: Builds a JSON file of the customer's own data (profile, addresses, tax profiles, consents, orders, quotes — never costs or margins) for them to download for a limited time.
requests.completeDeletionBody: The customer is anonymised, which can't be undone. Refused while orders, claims or receivables are open.
requests.rejectBody: For example when the requester couldn't be verified. The customer sees this reason.
requests.answerHint: The reason or details the customer will see.
requests.answerRequired: Give a reason of at least 3 characters.

consents.newVersionIntro: Takes effect from the chosen date (never back-dated). Earlier consents stay tied to the text they accepted.
consents.reasonHint: Kept in the history, e.g. revised on counsel's advice.
consents.incomplete: Fill in both texts and a reason of at least 3 characters.

agreements.newVersionIntro: Legal text from counsel, effective from the chosen date (never back-dated). Factories accept each new version; earlier acceptances keep referring to theirs.
agreements.incomplete: Fill in the Thai text and a reason of at least 3 characters.

canned.title: Canned responses
canned.tagsHint: Comma-separated; lower-case letters, digits and _ (spaces and dashes become _), e.g. production, lead_time
canned.required: Fill in the title and both texts.
canned.archiveBody: It leaves the inbox picker. You can restore it later.
canned.restoreBody: It shows in the inbox picker again.
canned.tagsInvalid: Tags use lower-case letters, digits and _, up to 30 long.
